explanation: Both bound reviews identify that proposal acceptance calls BareMirror.readBlob, which returns tree listings and symlink target text, while final adoption accepts only ordinary tracked files; an approved proposal can therefore stall every finalization attempt. The approved plan included evidence validation but omitted the existing mirror reader and its real-Git regression tests needed to expose a regular-file-only read. Extend the existing readBlob API with an optional regular-file constraint, preserving existing unconstrained callers and their injected mirrors, then use that constraint from proposal validation. This is necessary for the original tracked-entry-point validation requirement, adds no new feature or abstraction, and preserves the single basedOn product parent 4b1986e6a2a81ab956fb42371af2ce1af2ec8df4. No product edits have been made for this revision request.

additionalPaths.reason: Add an optional regular-file-only constraint to the existing BareMirror.readBlob method, inspecting the exact pin/path mode through its existing authenticated Git runner before returning bytes; reject trees, symlinks and missing paths while accepting ordinary and executable tracked files, including safe dot-directory paths, so submission validation agrees with adoption.

Extend the existing real-repository mirror fixture to verify the constrained read against tracked ordinary/executable files, a directory, symlink, missing path and safe hidden entry point, while checking unchanged default read behavior; mocked evidence responses alone cannot detect Git show accepting non-file entry points.
